critical_code_review_comments: friendly_error: the 'Connection' substring match is broad. Any ffmpeg log line containing 'Connection' (e.g. a mid-stream 'Connection reset' after a long live session) is reported as 'platform refused the stream/check key', which may mislead users when a long-running stream drops. Consider using the refused/key wording only when !session.confirmed, and a 'connection to platform lost' message otherwise.
GET /api/streams/history is capped with to_list(20), so count-based checks saturate once a user has 20+ entries. Consider pagination.
Earlier notes remain: the stream key is visible in the ffmpeg argv (ps), and relay upstream-connect failures are not logged.
